out.importBody: CRM ⇄ Desk Integration Email Providers Import Bring records into one Desk module from a CSV or Excel file. The file is checked before anything is written, and an import can be undone for 30 days. Import history Choose a module One module per import. The wizard maps your columns to that module’s fields and validates every row before it runs. Module Choose a module CSV, XLS or XLSX up to 25 MB and 30,000 rows. Rows beyond that are left out. Start import Import several modules from a ZIP One CSV per module inside the ZIP. Each file is matched to its module by name; the imports then run one after another through the same wizard, Accounts first, then Contacts, then Tickets. Choose
